job.value: set a weekly Coins budget for a Spotlight campaign

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Spotlight', 'Weekly budget', '15,000' Coins and 'Shared across 5 listings' make the job plain.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The slider with its large green knob is the only control.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: The slider is clear, but the grey thumbs-up tick at the middle has no label saying it's the recommended spend.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: The thumbs-up mark is unexplained and the Coin icon assumes the seller knows Coins pricing.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller picks 2,000–60,000 Coins with nothing saying what a budget buys (reach or clicks).

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Only the budget control is on screen.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: One number and a one-line caption carry it.
